description: Greedy rectangular partition of a coarse 2-4 grid, each region flood-filled with a random chromotome color over a stroke ground
notable: Whole sketch is deliberately kept to roughly 42 lines of code

description: Recursive binary subdivision of a square into alternating two-tone rectangles with white borders over a faint grid
notable: Split rectangles held in a tree; each new child flips between fg and bg

description: Binary square subdivision like breaking-down but colored with a complementary RYB hue pair, no borders and a finer grid
notable: Two complementary hues (h and h+180) instead of the fg/bg two-tone

description: Grid of woven cells in fill or stripe mode, progressively revealed top-to-bottom; contrast-filtered color pairs recall an Anni Albers silk tapestry
notable: Reveal driven by playhead sweeping a cell-count limit

description: Woven warp/weft grid using one randomly chosen weave draft (twill, herringbone, houndstooth, satin, waffle, monk's belt...) animating its shed offset
notable: Ten interlacement drafts share one (c,r,offset) boolean pattern signature

description: Woven warp/weft grid where each column and row draws its own hue from two oklch ramps; background lightness auto-chosen for WCAG contrast
notable: Per-thread color from oklch ramps; bg derived from a relative-luminance contrast calc

description: Weave draft painted onto the six faces of a 3D grid of boxes, rendered as oblique faces via the Heerich engine with the camera rotating
notable: Warp/weft/depth patterns each drive a different cube face - a woven volume

description: Weave draft extruded into a relief - warp cells raised, weft cells flat - rendered as oblique edge-shaded boxes via Heerich
notable: Height field from the weave pattern; face edges lightened/darkened from fill luminance

description: Plotter-ready SVG of a weave draft extruded as oblique white boxes with black outlines, scaled to an A4 page via Heerich
notable: Exports plotter SVG through Heerich.toSVG with a physical A4 viewBox

description: Vertical bands split into weave/solid/stripe cells drawn as bundles of thin warp/weft fibers, in Albers-inspired earthy palettes
notable: Fiber mode renders each thread as several hairlines for textile grain

description: Coarse grid of large flat oklch color planes where the weave pattern decides warp/weft dominance per cell; a hard-edged color field
notable: Weave logic repurposed as hard-boundary color-field composition

description: Near-monochrome oklch weave grid interrupted by a single accent column and row - one bright pop against a dominant color
notable: One accent warp plus one accent weft make a single chromatic interruption

description: Full-canvas woven field of warp/weft fiber hairlines using a chosen weave draft, then displaced by a per-pixel Perlin noise warp
notable: Post-process noise displacement distorts the finished weave like slack fabric

description: Elementary 1D cellular-automaton rows scrolling upward, colored per rule, then downsampled and Atkinson-dithered
notable: Wolfram rule (156/135/214...) drawn in color, then Atkinson dithered

description: Elementary 1D cellular automaton from a random seed row, generations scrolling upward as colored square cells
notable: Rule lookup uses an inverted index (7 - index)

description: Conway's Game of Life on a toroidal grid whose state changes XOR-accumulate into a display buffer with a fading decay trail
notable: XORs the transitions between GoL frames, not the live cells themselves

description: Same XOR Game-of-Life interference field as xor-game-of-life, but decay trails are colored from a pro-color-harmonies palette
notable: Decay counter indexes into the palette to color the trail

description: Elementary cellular automaton whose display XORs the rule output with the cell's own state, drawn as black cells on white and scrolling
notable: Random rule 0-255 each run; XOR of the rule bit with the center cell

description: Generative Bauhaus poster: a structural line anchors filled circles, semicircles, triangles and quarter-circles on a grid, with BAUHAUS set in negative space
notable: Places the word into the largest empty grid strip found via an occupancy scan

description: Bauhaus-style poster where clipped grid regions are filled by nalee space-filling walkers in contrasting color pairs, with Staatliches type
notable: nalee walkers clipped to grid rectangles act as poster color blocks

description: Variant of nalee-composition with more, smaller clipped nalee blocks spread across the grid, plus Staatliches title and date
notable: Five clipped nalee regions instead of two for a busier poster layout

description: Grid of tiles each with nested corner-anchored circles alternating by cell parity (Truchet-like), rampensau colors and a Staatliches caption
notable: Concentric discs pinned to alternating tile corners read as Truchet tiles

description: Bipolar coordinate diagram: families of constant-tau and constant-sigma circles drawn blue and red about two focal points on white
notable: Constant-coordinate curves of a bipolar system are two orthogonal circle families

description: The bipolar circle families filled as nested flat discs sorted large-to-small, cycling through an auto-albers palette as they animate
notable: Solid nested discs from bipolar coordinates create a moire-like concentric field
